name: trading-agent-mpu-gandring
changelog: Synchronized ticker polling across all watchlist and auto-trading symbols, added decimal stop-loss preprocessing, and enabled 1-click frictionless order execution
Full live trading support on Aster DEX with pinned trade-only agent wallet permissions and automatic startEquity calibration
Telegram Desk Lead supervisor integration with remote chat commands (status, report, positions, kill) and 5-minute health watchdog
Exact LIVE confirmation phrase displayed directly above the confirmation input box with click-to-fill support in Setup
Instant live balance display in TopBar and Portfolio (Paper/Live Book) with multi-country currency converter after Connect Wallet or API Key setup
Autonomous agent execution with interactive Token Picker chips and Max Open Positions in Desk Ops Auto Trade
description: Trading Agent Mpu Gandring: a desk of AI trading agents that argue, debate and (cartoon) fight over every trade, then pass a risk gate. Paper by default; full auto on testnet or live after a one-time setup, behind automatic guards. Comes with a cozy virtual office UI.
author: Abrur Alaina
